target.statement: Frobenius norm error ||Σ̂0 − Σ0|| of the streaming covariation-based robust covariance estimator under scenario A at a given contamination rate (e.g. r=10%), averaged over 100 simulated datasets of n=10,000 observations in d=10
target.table_ref: Figure 3 (scenario A, Frobenius norm error column)
target.dataset: Synthetic Gaussian mixture data (F0=N(0,Σ0), F1=N(μ1,Σ1)) generated per Section 4.1

compute.basis: No code released ('available upon request'); the full pipeline (online geometric median, MCM, Robbins-Monro eigenvalue reconstruction with nMC Monte-Carlo draws per step, per-step eigendecompositions, 100 replicates x 4 scenarios x several contamination rates) must be reimplemented from scratch, and the per-step O(d^3)+O(nMC d^2) cost over 10,000 points x 100 reps is the dominant runtime.

blockers: Full algorithm must be reimplemented from paper text, including unspecified hyperparameters (cγ, γ, n0, nMC, threshold c)
Results are only shown as figures, not exact numeric table cells, so exact reproduction of a value is ambiguous
title: Online robust covariance matrix estimation and outlier detection
